name: Microsoft 365

fastest.text: Go to account.microsoft.com/services/microsoft365, sign in and select Cancel subscription.

steps: Go to account.microsoft.com/services/microsoft365 and sign in with the account that pays.
Select Cancel subscription (it may say Upgrade or Cancel).
Read the Please review section at the top; it may suggest cheaper options.
At the bottom, select I don't want my subscription.
note: Bought through Google Play or a retailer such as Amazon? Contact them to cancel or ask for a refund.

faq.q: What happens to my OneDrive files?
faq.a: Your cloud storage drops to the free 5GB. If you're over it, you can't upload or sync new files or send and receive Outlook.com email, and after 6 months Microsoft may delete your OneDrive files.

faq.q: I see Turn on recurring billing instead of Cancel. Why?
faq.a: Your subscription is already set to expire. You won't be charged again and can use it until the end date.
Not every cancellation is refunded. Microsoft checks eligibility after you cancel.
Paying yearly, at $99.99/yr for Personal, costs less than twelve monthly payments of $9.99.
